description_en: Reruns a job to obtain the historical data of the job. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
description_zh: 重跑任务的历史数据，只有专业版才支持
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 rerun-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --job-id 123 --start-date 1645459200000 --end-date 1645718400000 --data-time 10:00:00 --region cn-hangzhou
